text.tspan: According to the National Student Clearinghouse Research Center (2016 data), the average amount of time it
takes students who begin college at a 4-year university to earn a 4-year degree is 5.0 years. A simple random
sample of 68 community college students who earned a 4-year degree had a sample mean time of 5.7 years
with sample standard deviation 1.82 years. Test the claim that it takes community college transfer students
longer than students who start at a university to earn a 4-year degree using significance level 0.05.
We will conduct a hypothesis test using STATBELT with

years, on average, to earn their degree. The null
hypothesis is that there is no change, and that
community college transfer students take the same
number of years to complete their degree. The
alternative hypothesis is that it takes them longer.
